data.title: 椎名真白 · 画室中央的新作
data.description: 樱花庄 202 室，她赤脚站在比人还高的画布前，白衬衫下摆沾满颜料，手里横握着画笔；回头看向门口时脸上毫无表情，发丝上还沾着一点钴蓝。
data.action: 手持画笔，站在大画布前回头看向门口。
data.promptProse: In Sakurasou Room 202, Mashiro Shiina stands before a canvas taller than herself and turns toward the doorway without changing expression. Her white shirt hem carries paint above navy ankle-length trousers, a brush held horizontally in her hand and cobalt blue caught in her hair. The medium portrait includes the easel legs and nearby paint surface. Soft daylight illuminates the canvas texture and pigment marks, with an easel shadow falling behind her.
